move: mic tap turns blue and breathes, rings radiate, waveform dances, transcript types, results stagger
how: A dark 760px search pill with a placeholder and a white mic button, a hint line and three hidden result rows. The pill rises in with expo.out over the first 6% of the 10s loop and a cursor glides to the mic. Tap at 1.5s (15%): the mic dips 0.85 then springs to 1.1 with elastic.out(1,0.45) as it turns blue; the placeholder drops away and a 28-bar waveform fades in whose bars scaleY from a per-bar sum of sines (seeded phases and frequencies) gated by a level proxy tweened 0 to 1; two rings radiate from the mic (scale 1 to 2.6 and 2.2, fading, power2.out) every 0.8s for six cycles; the mic breathes 1.1 to 1.0 on a 0.4s yoyo; the hint rolls to 'Listening…'. At 5.3s the level falls to 0, the waveform fades and TextPlugin types the transcript over 1.2s; the mic returns to white at 6.6s, the hint rolls to '3 results', and three rows rise from y 24 with expo.out staggered 0.12s at 7.0s. At 9.2s rows and the pill exit upward.
adapt: Change the placeholder, transcript, hint strings, result rows and the blue accent; bar count N and the sine frequencies set the waveform character. Keep the 0.8s ring cadence and the level-gated waveform envelope.
port: mount(el, shot) builds glow, search (q with ph/txt/wave bars, mic with two rings), hint and result rows inside el, seeding bar phases with fx.rng; register TextPlugin. animate returns the timeline with tap at 0.15D, rings from 0.17D every 0.08D, transcript 0.56D, results 0.7D, exit 0.92D; the waveform, which here is done by wrapping window.__fx.seek, becomes a D-long no-op tween on the same timeline whose onUpdate sets each bar's scaleY from tl.time() and the level proxy.
caveats: catalog says 20 seconds but the code and render are 10 seconds
waveform is driven by a monkey-patched window.__fx.seek, not by the timeline
cursor fades out at 1.8s and never returns, so the loop does not close on the cursor
backgroundColor and svg stroke tweened as colour strings
